summary: Performance Shipping Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice of Annual Meeting and Proxy Statement mailed to shareholders around October 6, 2026, for a meeting on November 4, 2026 in Athens. Shareholders of common and Series C Preferred vote as a single class on electing two Class I Directors and ratifying Ernst & Young (Hellas) as auditors for fiscal 2026. Record date is September 28, 2026; quorum is one-third of voting rights. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle apply.
